# teams_ai_policy (Resource)

Manages the AIPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsAIPolicy / Get-CsTeamsAIPolicy / Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsAIPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enroll_face` (String) Maps to the -EnrollFace parameter.
- `enroll_voice` (String) Maps to the -EnrollVoice parameter.
- `passive_voice_enrollment` (String) Maps to the -PassiveVoiceEnrollment parameter.
- `speaker_attribution_for_byod` (String) Maps to the -SpeakerAttributionForBYOD parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
